segments.mil3.7.14:1.1: Rājā āha “bhante nāgasena, sakkā sabbaṃ sukhumaṃ chinditun”ti?
segments.mil3.7.14:1.5: “Dhammo kho, mahārāja, sabbasukhumo, na kho, mahārāja, dhammā sabbe sukhumā,‘sukhuman’ti vā ‘thūlan’ti vā dhammānametamadhivacanaṃ.
segments.mil3.7.14:1.6: Yaṃ kiñci chinditabbaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ paññāya chindati, natthi dutiyaṃ paññāya chedanan”ti.
